item.title: Viral Photoshop Of Quentin Tarantino Glaring At Paul Dano Becomes A Meme Amidst 'Weak Actor' Drama
item.description: Quentin Tarantino Standing Behind Paul Dano or Tarantino Glaring at Paul Dano is an edited image of director Quentin Tarantino standing behind actor Paul Dano and glaring at him during a red carpet interview.
